summary: CKAN datastore_search errors (HTTP 200 with success:false) must surface as errors, not empty result sets.
reason: CKAN's /api/3/action/datastore_search always replies HTTP 200, signalling API-level failures (e.g. a stale/invalid resource_id) with {"success": false, "error": {...}} and no "result". Decoding only "result" yields records==nil/total==0, so a genuine API error was indistinguishable from 'no results'. A shared parseCKANDatastore helper checks the top-level success flag and wraps the CKAN error message before any no-records check.
validated_outcome: go build/vet pass; TestParseCKANDatastore covers success, success:false (message and __type fallback), and malformed JSON.
